observed.meaning: One resolution result per declared crossing, with noun, verb, attempt, ok and result; a failed result also carries class, exit and stderr.

sentinel.meaning: Result of the nonexistent-noun CLI sentinel probe.

couldChange.meaning: The handler reports false. Hyalos project_json constructs a projection without recording it.

attemptPerStep.meaning: Whether the handler reports attempting each step.

final.meaning: Resolved status and firstMissingSignal for the overall probe.

ok.meaning: True when the sentinel and all crossing resolutions succeed.

hyalos.meaning: A crossings-self-check projection; no Hyalos record is written by project_json. A projection failure is contained here.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists the fixed literal outcomes of a completed probe. Before a result exists the CLI can instead print caduceus-staff-crossings-failed: caduceus-crossings-manifest-missing, caduceus-staff-crossings-failed: caduceus-crossings-manifest-empty, or the open forms caduceus-staff-crossings-failed: caduceus-crossings-manifest-entry-invalid:<index> and caduceus-staff-crossings-failed: caduceus-crossings-manifest-entry-invalid:<index>:<noun-or-verb> to stderr; those are not firstMissingSignal fields.

schema.meaning: The existing CLI crossings result schema.
